title: Twenty GraphQL API — GraphQL
meta_description: Twenty GraphQL API on twenty.com: GraphQL endpoint, auth methods, and setup.
clean_text:
https://{your-workspace-url}/graphql
Authorization: Bearer <credential>
In your Twenty workspace, go to APIs / Settings → API & Webhooks (the MCP guide also refers to Settings → MCP & APIs → API ) and click + Create key . Copy the key immediately because it is shown once. You can scope the key by assigning it to a role under Settings → Members → Roles → Assignment tab .
Twenty uses per-workspace OAuth with dynamic client registration, so you do not create an app in a dashboard. Register your client programmatically against your workspace by POST ing to https://{your-workspace-url}/oauth/register as shown in the OAuth guide . Store the returned client_id and client_secret securely; they are then used for authorization-code or client-credentials token requests.
POST
https://{your-workspace-url}/oauth/register
client_id
client_secret
Authorization: Bearer <credential>
